user_decision: No pilot data yet; prepare the protocol
label_source: Reliable age-group information obtained with permission; never predicted ages or inferred birthdays.
consent: Record voluntary permission outside the repository. For minors, obtain appropriate guardian permission and participant assent. Do not store names, identity documents or birthdays in the manifest.
split: Assign participants to development or holdout before processing. Every photo of one participant must stay in one split; labels must agree. Reserve holdout until preprocessing, model artifacts and operating settings are fixed.
recommended_holdout_target: At least 30 distinct participants per age group, with realistic lighting/devices/pose variation. A small convenience sample is exploratory and cannot establish population accuracy.
photo_policy: Use ordinary photos representing the intended app, not only preselected successful face crops. Record failures and multiple-face selection. Keep photos private and outside version control/distribution packages.
quality_accounting: Report attempted/accepted/rejected images and reasons, coverage, conditional classification metrics and correct predictions divided by every attempted image. Never silently drop rejected photos.
reporting: Report per-class metrics, under-18 and senior boundary errors, participant/sample counts, image correlation and collection limits. No model result establishes chronological age or entitlement.
execution_command: python scripts/run_local_pilot.py --manifest PATH_TO_LABELS --photo-root PATH_TO_PHOTOS --output-dir PATH_TO_NEW_OUTPUT --split development
holdout_execution: After freezing the design, use the same command with --split holdout and a fresh output directory. Do not tune on its results.
